items.q: The skills students are building – leadership, resilience, and a willingness to serve - will carry them into whatever comes next, whether that is college, a career, the military, or starting a business in their hometown.

items.t: Said she is committed to regulatory reform and to improving internal policies to make state government more efficient.
items.q: We’re committed to delivering meaningful regulatory reform and improving internal policies to make state government more efficient and help more Montanans prosper.

record.t: Was elected Lieutenant Governor of Montana in 2020, the second woman elected to the office in the state's history.
record.q: Upon her election in 2020, Kristen became the second female elected lieutenant governor of Montana in the state’s history.

record.t: Leads the governor's Red Tape Relief Task Force, which works to cut regulations.
record.q: Kristen leads the governor’s Red Tape Relief Task Force to cut unnecessary, burdensome regulations that are a wet blanket on job creation and hamper small business owners, farmers, and ranchers.

record.t: Is involved in appointments to boards, commissions, and judicial vacancies.
record.q: Kristen plays a key role in policymaking, and is actively involved in appointments to boards, commissions, and judicial vacancies.

record.t: Reviewed a child welfare case at the governor's request and concluded that DPHHS and the court followed state policy and law.
record.q: Consulting with the director of DPHHS and personally examining case documents, Lieutenant Governor Juras has concluded that DPHHS and the court have followed state policy and law in their handling of this tragic case.

record.t: Announced 10 new Jobs for Montana Graduates chapters around Montana.
record.q: Juras announced 10 new chapters of JMG around Montana, building on a goal established in Governor Greg Gianforte’s 406 JOBS Initiative to expand the JMG program throughout the state.

record.t: Announced that Montana students can now receive a Workforce Readiness Credential from Jobs for America’s Graduates.
record.q: Juras announced that Montana students can now receive a Workforce Readiness Credential from Jobs for America’s Graduates, the national program with which JMG is affiliated.

record.t: Carried out a review of a case at the governor's order.
record.q: Gov. Greg Gianforte ordered Lt. Gov. Kristen Juras to carry out a review of the case.
